description: Add a new codec implementation that leverages bitcode's serde integration for serialization and deserialization. This codec should serve as an alternative to the existing Bitcode codec, specifically for types that implement serde traits but not bitcode's native Encode/Decode traits. The implementation should integrate seamlessly with the existing server function codec system.
functional_requirements: Implement a new BitcodeSerde codec struct that uses bitcode::serialize and bitcode::deserialize functions
Register the new codec in the server function codec registry alongside existing codecs
Ensure the codec properly handles serialization errors and returns appropriate error types
Add comprehensive tests demonstrating the codec works with serde-serializable types
Update Cargo.toml dependencies to include the necessary bitcode version with serde integration support
Document the new codec's purpose and usage in appropriate module documentation
